Free-grant amount (research suggests 300 cr / $3 on first run) + markup (keep ×1.25?) — founder undecided

decisions_resolved.decision: ADOPT the TON Agentic Wallets standard (provisional) for the agent budget-card / wallet layer rather than a fully custom enforcement — align future wallet work with TON's per-agent-funded-wallet + budget-cap + revocable primitive. Moat = curation / characters / open SPEC / author-rent, NOT 'agents spend crypto in TG'. The integration itself is a FUTURE build (TON SDK + the agentic-wallet primitive); the existing credit-ledger budget enforcement keeps working until then.

Gonka = 0% commission (BYO / pass-through) — the user pays Gonka directly, we don't tax it; matches the 'own provider = free' rule. We earn on the GRANT (paid in GNK), not on per-call Gonka margin. The GonkaGate platform fee only applies if we ever resell via our own key — deferred, not needed for the product.
